title: Remove the daemon front-door code the commercial plug host already serves
goal: Vision: V-9. Mandate 84, follow-up to T-GROKCORESIZE-1. Of the five daemon front doors, delete the core implementations that no core caller uses because susi-plug-host serves their plane topics (os_provision::dispatch for daemon.os.provision, ambient::start_report for daemon.ambient.start) together with their core-only tests, then re-pin COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the measured value. Public Rust contracts pinned by crates/susi-daemon/tests/public_daemon_api_contract.rs and the infallible local behaviours (ambient start/pulse, OS sampling, probe_all, privacy persist) stay in core per board 2817/2829/2833/2834/2835. No stubs and no lost function: the commercial DaemonHandlersPlug serves both and tests/daemon_handlers_plug.rs covers the same assertions.

reuse.searched: susi-commercial-apps src/daemon_handlers.rs (dispatch_provision, start_report) and tests/daemon_handlers_plug.rs already serve and test both; rg finds no core caller of either.

progress: Windows-green on Fury16 (rustc 1.99.0 msvc): susi-daemon lib 204 passed/5 ignored, susi-daemon-runtime lib 159 passed, architecture_tests 60 passed, lean_core_ceilings 3 passed/1 ignored, cargo fmt --check clean (susi-daemon, susi-daemon-runtime, susi), clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean on susi-daemon and susi-daemon-runtime. Measured complete socket 288,151 -> 288,040 (-111; runtime_rust 281,586 + vendor_facade 6,454); COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING 288,151 -> 288,040. cargo core-size reports 288,040 (goal unmet).
limitations: Small slice: the remaining five daemon front doors (ambient start/pulse, OS sampling, probe_all, privacy persist/set, services control facades) stay because public_daemon_api_contract.rs pins them and boards 2817/2829/2833/2834/2835 require their local behaviour without a plug host; deleting more needs a contract decision. Linux run for this exact tree is pending at landing time (CachyOS offline); the deleted code is unreferenced in core and its behaviour is served and tested in commercial. Pre-existing on main, not this change: gossip host_only AddrInUse flake (board 2897), child_home_isolation (board 2888/2913).
